latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of LiteParse: local document parsing for PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and images.
- Supports text extraction, JSON output with bounding boxes, and page-level screenshots.
- Enables batch processing of directories and selective page parsing.
- No cloud or LLM dependencies; works offline with Homebrew installation.
- Supports popular office and image formats with optional dependencies (LibreOffice, ImageMagick).
- Includes configurable options and support for reusable config files.
